## 4. Full-cost repair by lazy exact comparison

The full-sum implementation has a genuine defect: reached level n processes
Theta(n) integers of Theta(n) bits at interior frequencies, while level
probabilities decay as n^(-3/2). Its expected bit work diverges. Finite expected
cheap observations alone cannot justify promotion.

`factory_lazy.py` repairs this under a positive stationary plateau margin.
Predraw terminal degree independently, with probabilities 1-2e_n0 initially
and 2(e_m-e_n) at n=4m thereafter. Draw only that many cheap records and use
the conditional STOP heads coin

    q_n(k)=1/2+[h_n(k)-Elev(h_m)(k)]/[2(e_m-e_n)]

at later levels; initially use (h_n0(k)-e_n0)/(1-2e_n0). Telescoping of the
weighted heads polynomials proves the same exact f(p) law. This preserves the
degree distribution and expected cheap count. The predrawn degree remains a
private register; it is not appended to the ideal transcript.

If x=k/n lies on a plateau c, h_n(k)=c. Let g be its distance to the transition.
An elevated h_m coefficient differs from c only if J/m crosses the transition.
Consequently the one-sided hypergeometric Hoeffding bound gives

    |q_n(k)-1/2| <= R_m exp(-2m g^2),
    R_m=[11/40+M2/(8m)]/[2(e_m-e_n)].

No exponential-size rational denominator is needed. Set

    B=floor(2m g^2)-ceil(log2 R_m).

Since exp(-s)<=2^-floor(s), |q_n-1/2|<=2^-B. Compare an ideal uniform's bits
against the dyadic strip around 1/2 lazily. Away from that strip the answer is
known without an exact sum. On entering the strip, compute the exact q_n and
continue comparing against the SAME saved uniform prefix. Replacing that
uniform by a fresh coin on the strip would be incorrect. Exhaustive dyadic
prefix checks and a forced exact fallback exercise this detail in the code.

For the actual TV promise delta=1/600, every true p is at least
gamma=49/600 inside a plateau. At terminal degree n, the empirical count is
within gamma/2 of p except with probability <=2exp(-n gamma^2/2). On that
event its plateau distance is >=gamma/2. Thus a completely computable bound
on triggering any costly exact evaluation is

    T(n) <= min(1, 2*2^-floor(n gamma^2/2) + t(B_gamma(n))),
    B_gamma(n)=floor((n/4)gamma^2/2)-ceil(log2 R_(n/4)),
    t(B)=1 if B<2, and 2^(1-B) otherwise.

This decays exponentially up to a polynomial factor. For example the looser
bound T(n)<=min(1,4 n^(3/2)2^(-n gamma

# Completed substantive review of the observation-factory extension

Root read the full pinned N1073 governing proof, the complete new
`PROOF_EXTENSION.md`, and all used operation/factory/lazy code. The extension is
accepted at its stated mathematical and reference-runtime scope. This supersedes
pending-review labels in the worker's frozen handoff and verifier output; it
does not confer novelty, physical acquisition or practical advantage.

Governing pin:e1e2272165c8548326c31bb11817c28f871d21e9. Governing proof SHA256:
33007e1215fd91118e35be36b07b50ea3096b936b3c33c8e519b058d50ad4eb9.
Extension proof SHA256:7313f49d8f638dee659c726231e8205700288a6b4ac6da76a76e696f7b94eb0d.
This review uses the source's already-classical input and private-record contract;
it does not reaudit the old generic LP simplex implementation.

## Accepted construction and boundaries

1. For known rational L with distinct columns and strictly positive K, finite
   empirical classification followed by exact confusion-matrix inversion can
   simulate K without raw input. The positivity/norm argument and resource
   accounting are valid; no uniform polynomial-in-alphabet/bit-length claim.
   The particular source needs just two cheap calls. Root independently checked
   every rational output, one-call feasible certificate and common-part cost.
2. A fixed hard cheap-call budget under open stationary calibration uncertainty
   forces the common-part raw bound. The multinomial Bernstein uniqueness
   argument is sound and explicitly does not apply to unbounded stopping.
3. The corrected Bernstein envelopes nest on four-adic degrees. Root separately
   derived the hypergeometric variance cancellation and remainder estimates.
   The displayed M2/M3 bounds, rational radii and starting degree are conservative
   and valid. Constant envelope width gives the exact1385.96875 expected cheap
   calls. The naive implementation's bit-cost defect is not a theorem against
   all factories.
4. Predrawing terminal degree and using its conditional stop coin telescopes
   correctly. The lazy near-half interval is a conservative exact bound; fallback
   continues the same uniform prefix. It does not allocate exponentially large
   denominators on ordinary paths. With the positive margin at TV radius1/600,
   costly exact elevations are exponentially rare. Polynomial exact arithmetic
   and E[N log^c N]<infinity
